## Tried
- `2026-11-11` DECISION: Invoice lifecycle draft -> finalized -> void. Drafts get id DRAFT-<8 hex> and no number; finalize assigns the next gapless number, freezes the invoice and sets due_date = finalize date + tenant payment_terms_days (tenants.json, default 14, non-negative int). Void only from finalized, needs a non-blank reason. A voided number is never reused or freed; the numbered file stays in place with status void. Numbering year still comes from issue date, not finalize date.
